macros.name: fbDirectory
macros.doc: If you store your figure files at a central place on your file system, you may set \fbDirectory to point there.

macros.name: fbEpsfigM
macros.doc: Use \fbEpsfigM instead of \fbEpsfig to restrict the caption width to the figure width (M stands for minipage).

macros.name: fbEpsM
macros.doc: \fbEpsM includes the figure and sets the caption width to the figure width – \fbEps would set the caption width to the text width instead.

macros.name: fbList
macros.doc: Usually, \fbList generates a starred (i.e. without numbering) chapter or section “List of Figures”, depending on your document type.

macros.name: fbref
macros.doc: Use the commands \fbref and \fbrefpage to refer to figures. They generate complete references, not only numbers.

macros.name: fbTheFigs
macros.doc: You can give \fbTheFigs multiple times, creating several figure parts in your document.

macros.name: figbibBst
macros.doc: You may change the default BibTEX style file, which is figbib.bst, by redefining \figbibBst.

macros.name: figbibskip
macros.doc: In the figure parts, you may redefine the space \figbibskip between subsequent figures, e.g. \setlength{\figbibskip}{1cm}.

envs.name: fbMinipage
envs.doc: If you want to create a minipage inside an fbFloat environment, you should use the fbMinipage environment instead of the usual minipage.
